films.title: ABCs of Death 2 1/2
films.overview: An anthology of 26 fan entries submitted for inclusion in ABCs of Death 2, each offering various takes on the letter "M".

films.title: V/H/S/85
films.overview: Unveiled through a made-for-TV documentary, five chilling tales of found footage horror emerge to take viewers on a gore-filled journey through the grim underbelly of the forgotten 1980s.

films.title: Culture Shock
films.overview: A young Mexican woman crosses the border in search of the American dream, only to instead find her worst nightmare lying within.

films.title: Bingo Hell
films.overview: In the barrio of Oak Springs lives a strong and stubborn group of elderly friends who refuse to be gentrified. Their leader, Lupita, keeps them together as a community, a family. But little did they know, their beloved bingo hall is about to be sold to a much more powerful force than money itself.
